# nico_expected_switch (Data Source)

Expected Switch identifies an NVLink Switch that is expected to be discovered at a Site. Infrastructure Providers can pre-register Expected Switches using BMC, NVOS credentials and serial numbers to help with NVLink Switch discovery and ingestion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_expected_switch" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "expected_switch_name" {
  value = data.nico_expected_switch.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site to filter Expected Switches by

### Read-Only

- `bmc_ip_address` (String) Optional BMC IP address (IPv4 or IPv6). When set, pre-allocates a reserved IP for the BMC.
- `bmc_mac_address` (String) MAC address of the Expected Switch's BMC (Baseboard Management Controller)
- `created` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Switch was created
- `description` (String) Description of this component
- `host_id` (Number) Host ID within the tray
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined key-value pairs for organizing and categorizing Expected Switches
- `manufacturer` (String) Manufacturer of this component
- `model` (String) Model of this component
- `name` (String) Display name for this component
- `rack_id` (String) Optional rack identifier for this component
- `slot_id` (Number) Slot ID within the rack
- `switch_serial_number` (String) Serial number of the Expected Switch
- `tray_idx` (Number) Tray index within the rack
- `updated` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Switch was last updated
